messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm starting a config-only change during the midnight window: routing weights + queue_shim softcap + tinybatch tweak. Canary plan 1% -> 5% -> 20% if healthy. Pin routing for the canary slice. @deploy-bot pls start the rollout and tag the PR (#4567).

deploy-bot: @maria scheduled config rollout (window 00:00-02:00 UTC). Canary steps: 1% for 10m, then 5% for 20m, then 20% for 30m. Fallback: immediate revert to prior weights on manual rollback. Job id cx-4821.

kevin: Quick q — are we pinning the model variant on the canary? recommend pinning to v2-2025-03 for the canary and enabling the previous tinybatch=false as fallback. Also add a short TTL warmup for kvcache.

maria: Good call. Pinning model to v2-2025-03 for the canary slice and leaving default traffic to follow later. TTL warmup set to 45s. tinybatch toggled to 4 (down from 8) for canary. Config snippet pushed to PR:

```
routing.canary_weight=0.01
model.pin= v2-2025-03
queue_shim.soft_cap=0.7
tinybatch.size=4
kvcache.ttl_warmup_s=45
```

sasha: Metrics to watch: p99 latency, 95/99 token generation latency, kvcache miss rate, queue_shim depth, OOMs, and tenant error rate. Also watch host-level CPU/GPU util — throttling can hide error spikes.

oncall-lee: I’ll watch the dashboard. Quick guardrails: if p99 increases >300ms sustained for 5m OR tenant error rate >0.5% rolling 10m, we rollback immediately. Also if kvcache miss rate jumps +12% vs baseline, consider revert. :warning:

maria: Applying to canary 1% now. I’ll stay pinned to this thread and call rollback if we hit guardrails. Will post logs here.

deploy-bot: Applying config cx-4821 -> starting canary on 135 hosts (1% slice). Applied routing weights and tinybatch change. Logs:

```
[00:02:11] cx-4821: push start -> 135 hosts
[00:02:18] cx-4821: config write ok
[00:02:22] cx-4821: applied routing weights
[00:02:30] cx-4821: tinybatch set to 4 on canary
[00:04:05] cx-4821: kvcache warmup start
```

ops-bot: Healthcheck: canary 1% -> initial 3m checks passed. No 5xx or increase in error rate detected. Perf snapshot: p50 +8ms, p95 +22ms, p99 +35ms.

kevin: Good. I'll keep an eye on host-level mem pressure — tinybatch change sometimes increases transient mem. If we see >2 OOMs across canary in 15m we should unwind.

maria: Noted. Next ramp scheduled at 00:35 UTC to 5% if no regressions. If we need to revert we will: 1) revert routing weights, 2) flush queue_shim on canary hosts, 3) unpin model.

oncall-lee: Agreed on rollback steps. I'll be ready to execute revert. tagging @sasha @kevin for alerts. :thumbsup:

sasha: If we ramp, add a short smoke test that hits a few long-sequence paths (>=1024 tokens) to ensure kv-cache and batch behavior stay stable.

maria: Adding smoke test to the canary job now. Will post results in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Canary 1% -> smoke tests started (seq >=1024). Job cx-4821-smoke id s-1102.

ops-bot: Smoke tests: 0 failures after 7 runs. p99 for long sequences +40ms from baseline. No OOMs.

maria: Moving to 5% ramp in 3m if still green. Holding here and monitoring. Thanks all.

kevin: I'll stand by for the 5% ramp. If any host-level GPU mem >88% for >5m, call rollback.

maria: Final note — we'll keep the canary pinned for at least 60m after full ramp to 20% before broader rollout. If everything's clean we will merge PR #4567 release notes and mark change complete.
